Package com.microservices.warehouse.application.api

Class ResponseMessageType

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.application.api.ResponseMessageType
@Component public class ResponseMessageType extends Object
A component class that defines various ResponseFormat constants for standard response messages.

This class contains predefined response formats for different scenarios including success, errors, and various specific cases such as scope not found or feature persistence failure.

The constants provided in this class ensure consistency in response messages and codes across the warehouse service application.
